howToPlay: Brock is a marksman who excels at long-range pressure. Utilize Rocket Laces to reposition or Rocket Fuel to destroy terrain and open up the map for better angles. Choosing between More Rockets and Rocket No. 4 allows you to customize your firepower for either burst damage or sustained control.
gears: Equip RELOAD SPEED to keep your ammo count high, and DAMAGE to capitalize on your long-range attacks. SHIELD or HEALTH are excellent choices to improve your survivability in 1v1 encounters.
trait: This brawler is perfect for precise players who enjoy controlling space and dismantling enemy cover from a distance.
